platform_authoritative_outcome.failure_reason: Runner exited with test failures or runtime errors

failed_tests.error: locator.allTextContents: Execution context was destroyed, most likely because of a navigation

REQ-10.2.statement: The sort-save UI performs a full navigation immediately after the PUT request, which destroys the Playwright execution context before the official test reads the sorted list.
evidence: Final Playwright report: REQ-10.2 failed at /workspace/tests/REQ-10.2.spec.ts:17 during locator.allTextContents with an execution-context-destroyed navigation error.

Template archive a774fb34f1b6-template.zip, template/backend/src/server.js:1024-1039: the save handler calls fetch('/api/books/<id>/sort') and then window.location.href on both success and failure paths.

Template archive a774fb34f1b6-template.zip, template/backend/src/server.js:2242-2260: the PUT handler validates and persists contentsOrder, so the evidence does not support a missing sort API as the primary cause.
REQ-10.2.causal_boundary: The confirmed defect is the client-side navigation/lifecycle race. The supplied evidence does not prove an ordering algorithm defect.
REQ-10.2.required_fix_boundary: After a successful save, keep the document alive, update or retain the already-sorted list in place, close the sort panel, and surface an error without navigating on failure.

REQ-11.1.statement: The comment flow does not expose the submitted comment using the accessible heading contract exercised by the final test; it renders comments as list items and reloads after POST success.
evidence: Final Playwright report and failure details: REQ-11.1 timed out while waiting for getByRole('heading', { name: /This\s+page\s+needs\s+review\./i }).first().

Template archive a774fb34f1b6-template.zip, template/backend/src/server.js:1386-1403: comments are rendered as li elements under an h2 named Reader discussion, with no heading containing the submitted text.
Template archive a774fb34f1b6-template.zip, template/backend/src/server.js:1406-1436: the POST success callback calls window.location.reload().
Template archive a774fb34f1b6-template.zip, template/backend/src/server.js:2334-2364: the POST route validates, appends the comment, saves db.json, and returns 201.
REQ-11.1.causal_boundary: The supported root cause is the observable DOM/accessibility contract mismatch, with reload dependence as a secondary lifecycle risk. The evidence does not support declaring the POST persistence path itself failed.
REQ-11.1.required_fix_boundary: After a 201 response, append the returned comment in place using the official accessible text/heading contract, clear the input, and avoid an immediate reload.

final_status_and_scope.statement: The platform final result is FAILED at 4/6; the two failed tests above are authoritative for this run.

structural_path_mismatch.statement: The structural checker repeatedly reported missing backend/server.js while the generated template contains backend/src/server.js.

node_states_mapping.statement: Run JSON node_states marks every requirement test-passed although tests[] records REQ-10.2 failed and REQ-11.1 timedOut.
node_states_mapping.impact: Intermediate node state must not be used as final test evidence.

implementation_budget.statement: The REQ-10.2 implementation turn reached the 900-second cap, while the final six-node flow had a 9000-second budget.
implementation_budget.impact: The timeout consumed time that should have supported targeted repair and final verification; it is a contributing orchestration risk, not the final product failure classification.

process_cleanup.statement: Postflight logs show defunct chrome, node, npm start and pkill processes and broad stray-process cleanup.
process_cleanup.impact: Supports PID-owned service lifecycle and bounded cleanup as a generator reliability fix; no direct causal link to the two failed assertions is proven.

validation_separation.statement: The generator found no *.spec.ts under /workspace/tests and built internal checks from requirement text only, while the platform later executed the final Playwright suite.
validation_separation.impact: Internal acceptance must be labeled as a proxy and must not be reported as official Playwright coverage.

strong_candidate.limitation: The supplied final artifacts do not quantify a specific unbounded read or prove that it caused either failed test.

strong_candidate.limitation: This is a prevention recommendation, not a demonstrated causal event in the run.
